personality_one_liner: A highly readable, trustworthy, and calming clinical dashboard that uses warm off-whites and sage green to organize dense booking data with iOS-native fluidity.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around content. Use standard iOS spacing rhythms with clear grouping for data modules.

do's: Use glass on the bottom tab bar
Use glass on the sticky header when scrolling through the bookings list
Use glass on the bottom-sheet header/drag handle when rescheduling
dont's: Do not use glass on booking cards or dashboard metric cards
Do not use glass on form inputs

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: A simple email/password entry gate for clinic staff.
screens.layout: Full-screen layout featuring a top header space with the clinic logo, followed by clean input fields and a primary button. Use a soft background image with a vertical gradient scrim overlay to maintain extreme contrast for readability. No extra social logins required.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Provides instant visibility into weekly deals and daily booking operational metrics.

states.loading: Skeleton UI replicating the 4 metric cards.
states.empty: Illustration indicating 'No data for this week yet'.
states.error: Card overlay with a retry button to fetch Google Sheet data.

screens.layout: Header with 'Today's Overview'. Below, a 2-column grid of 4 metric cards (Total Deals, Bookings Left, Completed, Cancelled). Each card uses 'surfaceSecondary' with large 'Space Grotesk' numbers and an icon inside a 'brandTertiary' tinted rounded square. Below metrics, display a quick summary chart for weekly analytics.

screens.name: Bookings
screens.purpose: A master list of all bookings that clinic staff can search, filter, and drill into.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty calendar or folder with 'No bookings match your filters'.
states.error: Readable text block 'Unable to sync with Google Sheets' and a primary Retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky header with a full-width Search bar and a horizontally scrolling row of filter chips (Date, Status) directly beneath it. The list below uses accordion-style cards for each booking (Name, Phone, Time). Cards have status badges (Upcoming, Completed, Cancelled).

screens.name: Booking Detail Sheet
screens.purpose: Allows staff to view full details and trigger status updates or reschedule flows.

states.loading: Spinner on action buttons when webhook is firing.
states.error: Inline error near the action button if the webhook fails.

screens.layout: Presented as a bottom sheet over the Bookings list. Displays detailed patient info. Features two prominent action buttons: 'Mark Completed' / 'Cancel', and a 'Reschedule' button. Pressing reschedule transitions the sheet to a Date/Time picker view before submitting the webhook.

screens.name: Analytics
screens.purpose: Detailed weekly charts, completion rates, and historical trends.

states.empty: Illustration 'Not enough data to display trends'.
states.error: Error state with a retry button to fetch graph data.

screens.layout: Vertical scrollview with distinct sections for Weekly Trends (Bar chart) and Completion Rates (Line/Pie). Use 'surfaceSecondary' cards to encapsulate charts with clear 'Space Grotesk' metric callouts. Maintain ample spacing between sections.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Manage app configuration and n8n webhook URLs.

states.error: Validation error if the URL format is invalid.

screens.layout: Simple list of configuration options. Includes text inputs for Webhook URLs. Use standard iOS grouped list styling with a sticky 'Save' button pinned at the bottom of the scroll view.

empty_state_illustration.alt: Minimal abstract paper composition for empty states

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality. Avoid all muddy colors and blue hues. The accent color is exclusively Sage Green (#3C5A44).
Ensure touch targets are at least 44x44pt and apply hitSlop where visual footprint is smaller.
Implement a Gradient-to-Dark Scrim (Top -> Bottom, Transparent -> #1A1A18) on the 'Login' screen background image, guaranteeing text contrast.
The 4 metric cards on the Dashboard must use a 2-column grid utilizing flexWrap and space-between layout.
When integrating n8n webhooks, ensure real-time visual feedback (loading spinners, success haptics, error toasts) since API latency might vary.
For the Bookings list, place a search bar at the top with horizontally scrolling filter chips right underneath to mimic high-end patterns from Mobbin/60fps.design.
Booking cards should utilize tinted icon containers (brandTertiary rounded square) for status differentiation.
